name: memoryai-mobile
description: MemoryAI native mobile host for the existing Next.js product core.

scripts.sync:debug: npm run build:debug && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run sync:debug && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release-audit: npm run build && cap sync android && npm run verify:config && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run sync && cap sync ios
